description: Planet intrinsic ability templates. Registered as IAbilitySource via PlanetIntrinsicAbilitySource (PROJ-301). Keys are PlanetType enum names. Empty `abilities` is fine for benign types. {"min": x, "max": y} ranges are rolled at galaxy generation via roll_intrinsic_abilities (helper from PROJ-300). Optional per-ability `chance` field (float in [0.0, 1.0], default 1.0) gates whether the ability fires for a given planet — FEAT-15 makes planet effects rare flavour rather than default behaviour.

CONTINENTAL.name: Continental
CONTINENTAL.description: Earth-like world; no significant intrinsic effects.

ARID.name: Arid
ARID.description: Desert world; thin water vapor reduces sensor accuracy slightly.

PELAGIC.name: Pelagic
PELAGIC.description: Ocean world; benign sector with no intrinsic hazards.

MAGMA.name: Magma
MAGMA.description: Volcanic hellscape; ejected plasma and radiation buffet ships in orbit.

CRYOPLANET.name: Cryoplanet
CRYOPLANET.description: Frozen surface; cold-trapped gases reduce thrust efficiency in low orbit.

JOVIAN.name: Jovian
JOVIAN.description: Gas giant; deep gravity well slows strategic transit through this hex.

ICE_GIANT.name: Ice Giant
ICE_GIANT.description: Distant gas/ice giant; ammonia haze interferes with shields.

CHTHONIAN.name: Chthonian
CHTHONIAN.description: Stripped giant core; radioactive remnants emit constant flux.

PLANETOID.name: Planetoid
PLANETOID.description: Large asteroid or dwarf planet; benign.

DYSON_SPHERE.name: Dyson Sphere
DYSON_SPHERE.description: Artificial megastructure; intense radiation in operational hexes.
